text:
riley: PSA: tried to be eco-friendly and built a standing desk out of Amazon boxes. It works... until the cat sits on the top box and everything tilts. Posted a pic: https://files.slack.com/archives/random/FNEW1234/IMG_20260610.jpg

anika: Champion of sustainability + chaos. 😂 If it's wobbly, stack a flat board on top and use binder clips to secure boxes together. Also non-slip shelf liner under feet.

carlos: Also check load on the desk — monitors + docking station + plant = tipping hazard. Love the ingenuity tho.

riley: True. Also weird thing: my smart speaker decided to join the meeting and played my grocery list aloud mid-standup. Mortifying. :scream_cat:

morgan: HA. Mute smart speaker mic or set "do not disturb" routines during meetings. If it's an Alexa/Google Home, `disable voice purchases` and add a quick routine: "When event starts, do not disturb."

petra: Network side: had a neighbor doing a "LAN party" tonight and my packet loss spiked. If you have a router with QoS, prioritize your laptop's MAC or put the gaming box on low priority.

carlos: For quick QoS check on home routers: login to 192.168.1.1 (or check companion app). If nothing fancy, temporarily enable AP isolation or move to 5GHz.

it-support-bot: Tip: "If you rely on video/audio for demos, keep a USB ethernet adapter handy. For macOS: `ifconfig` shows interface names. For Windows: use `ipconfig /all` to confirm the adapter gets an IP." :robot_face:

anika: Also as a software trick, use `pstree` or Activity Monitor to kill big uploads (Dropbox/Google Drive) during calls. Background sync loves to ruin your bandwidth.

riley: Great ideas. I unplugged the speaker, taped the boxes down, forced 5GHz, and paused Dropbox sync. Standing desk survived the rest of the day. Posting victory pic tomorrow if the cat doesn't sabotage it. :tada:

morgan: Bonus: if you're worried about wobble, add a light cross-brace using a broom handle and some zip ties. Engineering solution. :hammer_and_wrench:

petra: If anyone wants, the company home office stipend still covers a proper standing desk if the cardboard life gets too stressful — check People Ops FAQ.

carlos: Also one-liner QoS check for Linux nerds: `sudo tc -s qdisc` shows if your interface is being throttled.

riley: Thanks y'all. Cat has already claimed the top box as throne. I'm calling it ergonomics with character. :cat:
